terms.name: Customer
terms.definition: A registered buyer of Lumo Outdoors; one row per customer in customers.
terms.scope: All order, tier and region analysis

terms.name: Order
terms.definition: A purchase transaction placed by a customer; one row per order in orders, with one or more order items.
terms.scope: All order counting; includes pending and cancelled orders

terms.name: Valid Order
terms.definition: An order whose status is paid, shipped or delivered (status 1, 2, 3). Pending-payment (0) and cancelled (9) orders are not valid orders.
terms.scope: Basis for order counts, revenue, average order value, repeat customers and channel share

terms.name: Order Status
terms.definition: Lifecycle state of an order, stored as integer code (0 pending payment, 1 paid, 2 shipped, 3 delivered, 9 cancelled).

terms.name: Order Time
terms.definition: Time an order was placed; stored in UTC and reported in Taipei time (UTC+8) for day, month, quarter and year.
terms.scope: Period attribution of orders, order counts, revenue and average order value

terms.name: Sales Channel
terms.definition: Channel through which an order was placed: web (官網), app (行動 App) or store (實體門市).

terms.name: Mobile App Channel
terms.definition: Orders placed through the mobile app (channel value app).

terms.name: Customer Tier
terms.definition: Membership level of a customer: B (一般會員), S (銀級會員), G (黃金會員); current value per customer.

terms.name: Gold Member
terms.definition: Customers whose tier is G (黃金會員).

terms.name: Customer Region
terms.definition: Region or country code of a customer: TW-N 北部, TW-C 中部, TW-S 南部, JP 日本, SG 新加坡; current value per customer.

terms.name: Northern Taiwan Region
terms.definition: Customers whose region_code is TW-N (北部).

terms.name: Product
terms.definition: A sellable item in the catalog; one row per product in products.

terms.name: Active (On-sale) Product
terms.definition: Products currently on sale (is_active = 1); is_active = 0 means delisted. A current-state flag, not time-versioned.
terms.scope: Questions about products currently on sale

terms.name: Product Category
terms.definition: Merchandise category of a product: backpack 登山背包, tent 帳篷, shoes 登山鞋, apparel 機能服飾, accessory 配件.

terms.name: Order Item
terms.definition: A product line within an order (quantity at a transaction unit price); one row per order_items record.

terms.name: Payment Record
terms.definition: An attempt to pay an order; one row per payments record. An order can have several records (failed attempts plus at most one successful).

terms.name: Payment Method
terms.definition: How a payment was made: credit_card 信用卡, line_pay LINE Pay, atm ATM 轉帳, cod 貨到付款.

terms.name: Refund
terms.definition: A refund granted against one item of an order; one row per refunds record, referencing the item and its order.

terms.name: Refund Time
terms.definition: Time a refund occurred; stored in UTC and reported in Taipei time (UTC+8).
terms.scope: Period attribution of the refund report

terms.name: Item Amount
terms.definition: Merchandise value of an order item: quantity times the transaction unit price (actual price paid, discount already included, not the catalog list price), expressed in TWD.
terms.scope: Basis of revenue and average order value

terms.name: Refund Amount Attributed to Original Order
terms.definition: Refund amount deducted from the original order's revenue, assigned to the period of the order's creation time regardless of when the refund occurred.

terms.name: Net Revenue
terms.definition: Sum of item amounts of valid orders in the period (by order time) minus refund amounts of those orders.
terms.scope: Revenue reporting by period, tier, region, channel

terms.name: Average Order Value
terms.definition: Sum of item amounts of valid orders in the period (refunds not deducted) divided by the number of valid orders in the period.

terms.name: Repeat Customer
terms.definition: A customer with at least 2 valid orders within one (Taipei) calendar year.

terms.name: App Order Share
terms.definition: Share of valid orders in a period that were placed through the mobile app, as a percentage of valid order count.

terms.name: Received Amount
terms.definition: Total amount of successful payment records (payment_status ok); failed attempts are excluded.
terms.scope: Money actually received, by payment method

terms.name: Refund Amount (Refund Report)
terms.definition: Total refund amount attributed to the period in which the refund occurred (refund time), as used by the refund report.
terms.scope: Refund reporting by period or product category

terms.name: Sales Quantity
terms.definition: Number of units sold of a product, summed over order item quantities.

relations.connection_condition: valid orders are orders.status in the paid/shipped/delivered values
relations.description: A valid order is a subset of orders (status paid, shipped or delivered).
The mobile app channel is one value of the sales channel dimension.
Gold member is one value of the customer tier dimension.
Northern Taiwan is one value of the customer region dimension.
On-sale products are the subset of products flagged active.
An order is composed of one or more order items; an item cannot exist without its order.
Payment records are attempts attached to an order; an order may have several (failed attempts and at most one successful).

relations.connection_condition: refunds.order_id references orders.order_id; refunds.item_id references order_items.item_id of the same order
relations.description: A refund is granted against an item of a specific order and cannot exist without it.
A customer places orders; customer attributes (tier, region) are current values, not values at order time.
Each customer has one current membership tier.
Each customer has one current region code.
An order item sells one product at a transaction price.
Each product belongs to one merchandise category.
Each order is placed through one sales channel.
A refund's product category is indirect: it is the category of the product of the refunded order item.
Each payment record uses one payment method.

relations.connection_condition: both read refunds.refund_amount_twd; they differ in period attribution
relations.description: Same underlying refund amounts attributed to different periods: refund-report amount follows refund time, order-attributed amount follows the original order time. They are not interchangeable.
Net revenue is built from item amounts of valid orders minus order-attributed refunds.
Order-attributed refunds are subtracted when deriving net revenue.
Net revenue only covers valid orders.
Average order value is total item amount divided by valid order count; refunds are not deducted.
Valid orders provide both the amount base and the divisor of average order value.
Repeat customers are derived by counting valid orders per customer within a calendar year.
App order share is derived from valid order counts overall and for the app channel.
The app channel valid-order count is the numerator of app order share.
Received amount is the sum of amounts of successful payment records.
Sales quantity is the sum of order item quantities per product.

constraints.scope: Whenever orders.status is filtered or labeled
constraints.description: orders.status is an integer code: 0 = 待付款 (pending payment), 1 = 已付款 (paid), 2 = 已出貨 (shipped), 3 = 已送達 (delivered), 9 = 已取消 (cancelled).

constraints.scope: Any order count, revenue, average order value, repeat-customer or channel-share question
constraints.description: A valid order has status paid, shipped or delivered (1, 2, 3). Pending-payment (0) and cancelled (9) orders are excluded. In the data, exactly the status 1/2/3 orders carry a successful payment record, which supports this definition.

constraints.scope: Any monetary computation based on order_items
constraints.description: order_items.unit_price_cents is in 1/100 TWD (cents), while payments.amount_twd and refunds.refund_amount_twd are in TWD. Item amount in TWD = quantity x unit_price_cents / 100. The unit price is the actual transaction price (80-100% of list price), not products.list_price_twd. Unit conversion is required before combining with refunds or payments.

constraints.scope: Whenever orders.order_ts is used to define a day, month, quarter or year
constraints.description: Per the business glossary, order timestamps are stored in UTC but all operational reports use Taipei time (UTC+8) to assign dates, months, quarters (Q1 = Jan-Mar) and years. The UTC storage itself cannot be verified from the data (hour-of-day is uniform); the glossary is the only source. The shift matters: 13 orders fall outside Taipei year 2025 by UTC bounds and 23 orders change calendar month.

constraints.scope: Whenever refunds.refund_ts is used to define a period
constraints.description: refund_ts is stored in UTC and reported in Taipei time (UTC+8), per the glossary only. Refund timestamps extend to 2026-01-13, and 3 refunds change calendar month under the +8h shift.

constraints.scope: Net revenue for any period, tier, region or channel
constraints.description: Net revenue = item amounts of valid orders in the period minus refunds of those same orders. The period is the order creation time (Taipei time); each refund is deducted from its original order regardless of when the refund occurred. 101 of 194 refunds fall in a different Taipei month than their order, so using refund time instead would give a different total.

constraints.scope: Average order value for any period
constraints.description: Average order value = total item amount of valid orders in the period (refunds NOT deducted) divided by the number of valid orders in the period (Taipei time, order creation time).

constraints.scope: Repeat-customer counts per year
constraints.description: A repeat customer has at least 2 valid orders within the same Taipei calendar year; orders in other years or non-valid orders do not count. Distinct customers are counted, not orders.

constraints.scope: Any question about money received or amounts by payment method
constraints.description: Received amount counts only payment records with payment_status = ok. Failed attempts also store a non-zero amount_twd (613 failed rows, e.g. 2.9M TWD for credit_card) and 303 failed attempts belong to valid orders; including them overstates received money.

constraints.scope: Refund-report totals by period or category
constraints.description: Refund amount in the refund report is attributed to the period of refund occurrence (refund time, Taipei time), which differs from the order-based attribution used for net revenue. For a category breakdown, the category is that of the refunded item's product. Historical questions ('歷史上') span all refunds with no period restriction.

constraints.scope: Whenever orders.channel is filtered or labeled
constraints.description: orders.channel values: web = 官網, app = 行動 App, store = 實體門市.

constraints.scope: Channel-share percentages
constraints.description: The share is measured on valid order counts (denominator: all valid orders of the period, numerator: valid orders of the app channel), not on amounts. The glossary does not state the basis of '占比' explicitly; order-count basis is the natural reading of the question wording.

constraints.scope: Whenever customers.tier is filtered or labeled
constraints.description: customers.tier values: B = 一般會員, S = 銀級會員, G = 黃金會員.

constraints.scope: Whenever customers.region_code is filtered or labeled
constraints.description: customers.region_code values: TW-N = 北部, TW-C = 中部, TW-S = 南部, JP = 日本, SG = 新加坡. Only TW-N is northern Taiwan; JP and SG are overseas.

constraints.scope: Questions that segment historical orders by customer tier or region
constraints.description: Tier and region exist only as current values on the customer row (no history, not copied onto orders). Segmenting past orders by tier or region therefore uses the customer's current value; historical tier/region at order time is not recoverable from this data.

constraints.scope: Whenever payments.method or payments.payment_status is filtered or labeled
constraints.description: payments.method: credit_card = 信用卡, line_pay = LINE Pay, atm = ATM 轉帳, cod = 貨到付款. payments.payment_status: ok = 付款成功, failed = 付款失敗.

constraints.scope: Whenever products.category or products.is_active is filtered or labeled
constraints.description: products.category: backpack = 登山背包, tent = 帳篷, shoes = 登山鞋, apparel = 機能服飾, accessory = 配件. products.is_active: 1 = 在售 (on sale), 0 = 已下架 (delisted); delisted products still appear in historical order items.

constraints.scope: Questions restricted to products currently on sale
constraints.description: is_active is a current-state flag with no history. 'Currently on sale' filters on the present flag, while the sales being ranked may include periods before a product was delisted.

constraints.scope: Product ranking by units sold
constraints.description: The glossary does not define which orders count toward sales quantity. Valid-order quantity is the consistent reading with the valid-order convention. In the construction data, ranking active products by all-order quantity and by valid-order quantity returns the same top product, so the choice did not change the ranking there.

constraints.scope: Combining orders with order_items or payments
constraints.description: Orders, order items and payment records are different grains: 5238 items over 3000 orders; 244 orders have 2 or 3 payment records (failed attempts plus a success). Order counts must be at order grain and not inflated by item or payment rows; amounts must not be duplicated by multi-row joins.

evidence.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
evidence.result: status values: 0=155, 1=169, 2=232, 3=1978, 9=466 (code meanings come from domain_knowledge.md 代碼對照: 0待付款,1已付款,2已出貨,3已送達,9已取消)

evidence.query: SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2; and SELECT n,COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) n FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1) GROUP BY 1
evidence.result: status 1/2/3 orders have 169/232/1978 'ok' payments; status 0 and 9 orders have 0 'ok' payments (only failed or no payment). Every order with an 'ok' payment has exactly 1 (2379 orders = 169+232+1978). This corroborates the glossary definition that only status 1,2,3 are effective (paid) orders.
evidence.validation_method: cross-table consistency check between orders.status and payments.payment_status

evidence.query: WITH t AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 gross FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1), p AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_twd) a FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1) SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(p.a=t.gross), SUM(p.a<>t.gross) FROM t JOIN p USING(order_id); and SELECT MIN(i.unit_price_cents/100.0/p.list_price_twd), MAX(...), AVG(...) FROM order_items i JOIN products p USING(product_id); and SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE unit_price_cents % 100 <> 0
evidence.result: For all 2379 valid orders, SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100 equals the order's successful payment amount_twd (2379 equal, 0 different). unit_price_cents/100 divided by products.list_price_twd ranges 0.80 to 1.00 (avg 0.946), i.e. unit_price_cents is in 1/100 TWD and is a discounted transaction price at or below list price. All unit_price_cents values are multiples of 100 (0 exceptions).
evidence.validation_method: reconciliation of two independent columns; unit ratio against list price

evidence.query: read poc/build_input/domain_knowledge.md sections 一 (報表時間規則) and 二 (名詞定義)
evidence.result: Business glossary states: timestamps are UTC and reports use Taipei time (UTC+8); 有效訂單=status 已付款/已出貨/已送達; 商品金額=數量×成交單價; 淨營收=有效訂單商品金額總和 minus refunds of those orders, attributed by order creation time; 客單價=有效訂單商品金額(不扣退款)/有效訂單張數; 回購客戶=same-year valid orders >=2; 實收金額=sum of successful payments; 退款金額(退款報表)=attributed by refund time.
evidence.validation_method: documentary source (business-provided); data corroboration recorded in separate evidence items; UTC claim itself cannot be verified from data

evidence.query: SELECT SUM(strftime('%Y',order_ts)<>strftime('%Y',datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'))), SUM(substr(order_ts,1,7)<>substr(datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'),1,7)) FROM orders; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_ts<'2024-12-31 16:00:00' OR order_ts>='2025-12-31 16:00:00'; SELECT CAST(substr(order_ts,12,2) AS INT) h, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1; SELECT SUM(substr(refund_ts,1,7)<>substr(datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours'),1,7)) FROM refunds; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours')>='2026-01-01'
evidence.result: orders.order_ts range is 2024-12-30 02:32:52 to 2025-12-31 21:03:34 (stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', no zone marker). Shifting +8h changes the calendar year for 3 orders and the calendar month for 23 orders (3 of these are in 2025-03/2025-06 UTC); 13 orders fall outside Taipei calendar year 2025. Order hour-of-day is roughly uniform (107-146 per hour) so the data alone cannot confirm the zone. For refunds, 3 refunds change month under +8h and 6 refunds occur in Taipei 2026 (refund_ts max 2026-01-13).
evidence.validation_method: boundary-impact measurement; zone itself taken from glossary

evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(i.order_id<>r.order_id) FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id; SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM refunds; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id WHERE r.refund_amount_twd > i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents/100.0; SELECT SUM(r.refund_ts<o.order_ts) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id)
evidence.result: All 194 refunds reference an item whose order_id equals refunds.order_id (0 mismatches); all 194 refunds belong to status=3 orders; 194 refunds over 176 distinct orders; no refund exceeds its item line value (0); no refund precedes its order (0). item_id values are unique within refunds.

evidence.query: SELECT SUM(substr(datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours'),1,7)<>substr(datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'),1,7)), COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id)
evidence.result: 101 of 194 refunds occur in a different Taipei month than their original order, so attribution by order time (net revenue) and by refund time (refund report) give different period totals.

evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.category), COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i USING(item_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id)
evidence.result: All 194 refunds resolve through refunds.item_id -> order_items.product_id -> products.category; 5 distinct categories are reachable. refunds has no product or category column of its own.

evidence.query: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY channel; SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY channel
evidence.result: orders.channel values: app=1044, store=453, web=1503 (valid orders: app=833, store=350, web=1196). Labels web=官網, app=行動 App, store=實體門市 from glossary. No NULL or variant spellings.

evidence.query: SELECT tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY tier
evidence.result: customers.tier values: B=274, G=49, S=77; no NULLs. Labels B=一般會員, S=銀級會員, G=黃金會員 from glossary.

evidence.query: SELECT region_code, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region_code
evidence.result: customers.region_code values: JP=46, SG=18, TW-C=93, TW-N=153, TW-S=90; no NULLs. Labels TW-N=北部, TW-C=中部, TW-S=南部, JP=日本, SG=新加坡 from glossary. JP and SG are countries, not Taiwan regions.

evidence.query: SELECT method, payment_status, COUNT(*), SUM(amount_twd) FROM payments GROUP BY 1,2
evidence.result: payments.method values: atm, cod, credit_card, line_pay; payment_status values: ok and failed. ok totals: atm 344 rows/3,461,775; cod 250/2,422,200; credit_card 1298/12,773,170; line_pay 487/4,795,025. failed rows (613 total) carry non-zero amount_twd too (e.g. credit_card failed 312 rows/2,911,335), so failed rows must not be summed as received money.

evidence.query: SELECT n, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) n FROM payments GROUP BY 1) GROUP BY 1; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items; SELECT SUM(payment_status='failed') FROM payments p JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3)
evidence.result: payments per order: 1 payment for 2445 orders, 2 for 185, 3 for 59 (2689 orders have payments; 311 have none). 303 failed payments belong to valid orders. order_items has 5238 rows over 3000 orders, so orders, items and payments are different grains (one order to many items / payments).

evidence.query: SELECT category, is_active, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY 1,2; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku), COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) FROM products
evidence.result: products: 60 rows, 60 distinct skus/names. category values: accessory, apparel, backpack, shoes, tent (12 each). is_active=1 for 50 products, 0 for 10 (accessory 1, apparel 1, backpack 1, shoes 3, tent 4). Inactive products still appear in historical order_items.

evidence.query: SELECT n, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' AND datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1) GROUP BY 1
evidence.result: Customers by number of valid Taipei-2025 orders range 1 to 25; 41 customers have exactly 1 and the rest (the majority) have 2 or more, so the >=2 threshold is a meaningful split. 346 of 400 customers have any order.
evidence.validation_method: distribution inspection of the glossary threshold

evidence.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM products); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items)
evidence.result: 0 orphan orders->customers, 0 orphan order_items->products, 0 orders without items. orders.customer_id, order_items.order_id/product_id, payments.order_id, refunds.order_id/item_id behave as foreign keys (no declared FK constraints exist in the schema).

evidence.query: PRAGMA/--schema of customers: customer_id, name, email, region_code, signup_date, tier
evidence.result: customers holds one row per customer with a single tier and a single region_code and no effective-date or history columns; orders carry no copy of tier/region. Tier and region therefore describe the customer's current state, not their state at order time.

evidence.query: top active product by SUM(order_items.quantity) over all orders vs over orders with status IN (1,2,3), restricted to products.is_active=1
evidence.result: The glossary does not define 銷售數量. Computing the top active product by quantity over all orders and over valid orders only yields the same product in the current data (comparison returned 1 = same). The definition is therefore unconfirmed but did not change the ranking in the construction data.
evidence.validation_method: sensitivity comparison of two candidate definitions
